recentItems.title: WFRV Local 5 News at Noon Open - New Voiceover | June 23, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The noon open for CBS affiliate WFRV in in Green Bay, Wisconsin.

WFRV is following several other Nexstar stations in dropping their current voice artists for cheaper voice services at SpotVoice. Recently, they dropped longtime voiceover for more than 20 years Eric Gordon for SpotVoice talent Sean King.

Graphics are the "CBS_01" look from Nexstar and music is "Locals Only" from Stephen Arnold Music.

recentItems.title: KJTL Texoma's FOX News at 9 Open | January 27, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza: https://discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 9pm news open for FOX affiliate KJTL licensed to Wichita Falls, Texas, also serving the Texoma area. Newscast is produced by KFDX.

There's no new voiceover change here, but I do find it amazingly weird (and cool?) that KJTL continues to use Stephen Arnold's Extreme package with the sound effects and how they still mention that they're in high-definition. If it ain't broke, don't fix it I guess lol.

Graphics are the FOX_01 package from Nexstar and the male voiceover remains unidentified.
